name: fooyin
blurb: fooyin is a music player built around customisation.
description:
fooyin is a music player built around customisation. Arrange its interface from a blank
canvas, start with a preset layout, and tailor its widgets and shortcuts to suit you.

Browse and filter your library, edit tags and artwork, and organise tracks into playlists
or autoplaylists. Play local music, archives, Audio CDs, and internet radio with gapless
playback. Shape the sound with ReplayGain, fading, and DSP chains, or convert audio
between formats.

Extend the player with plugins providing additional audio formats, widgets, visualisations,
and scrobbling services. FooScript enables advanced display formatting, library
queries, autoplaylists, and custom widget behaviour.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
